test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Snail’s pace
solution:
The correct answer is, '**Very slow**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A snail moves very slowly and keeps the same slow pace even through the troubles.
 
• **A snail's pace** means **moving very slowly**.
 
 
• Example, ***Aarav writes only one page for his book every day, and his work is moving at a snail's pace**.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Very fast**, doesn't match a snail's characteristics.
 
• **Very active**, snails don't change their pace which means they are forever slow and not active, irrelevant.
 
• **Very sharp**, snails don't seem to mind to the trouble much. They don't respond to it, irrelevant.
